title: Causal and noncausal latent inference under missing neural observations
scientific_question: Does flexible latent-state inference retain behavioral information under the full published missing-observation regime, and how do causal filtering and noncausal smoothing differ?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: Dynamical flexible inference of nonlinear latent factors and structures in neural population activity

data.access: Open metadata; same immutable release candidate as DPAD, but independent paper-session reconciliation required.
data.representation: Sorted spike/kinematic arrays; no raw voltage or author result CSV needed.

official_code.license: USC educational/research/nonprofit permission; commercial permission separate.
official_code.publication_identity: Current code not asserted historical; paper page says updated, so correction/version audit required.

complete_scope: Entire public grid-reaching missing-observation assay, all paper-defined sessions, folds, observation ratios and both inference regimes. Preserve public-dataset subclaim boundary; do not claim the request-only reaching/saccade cohorts reproduced.

outputs: Full published missingness-ratio curves and LDM/SAE comparisons at named0.3/0.6 settings, with exact observed-versus-dropped semantics still held
baselines: SAE zero and last/next average imputation

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Reduce held-session integrated behavior prediction loss across the frozen missingness curve; report causal latency/cost separately. Additional burst-dropout evaluation is prospective, not the published uniform-dropout reproduction.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Complete held temporal blocks/session; missingness seeds frozen independently of labels; animal-level limitation disclosed.
controls: Past-only imputation in causal arm; future average only in smoothing arm
Uniform and separately labeled burst masks

resources.basis: Complete published grid-reaching cohorts/folds, full missingness curves and three model families; models fit once per train fold and reuse weights across masks when identical.

remaining_gates: Paper update/correction and original mask/grid definition
Historical code/runtime reconciliation and license review
Bind exact observed-versus-dropped ratio semantics; retain dossier/review wording discrepancy until source resolves it.
overlap: Same data family as DPAD and NEURAL-023/024, but primary endpoint is flexible inference under missing samples rather than nonlinear-placement or across-day decoding.
participant_inputs: All public grid-reaching sessions/trials required by Figure7e and ED6e–f, spike/kinematic inputs under the identical frozen source-defined missingness masks; no published resultCSV or unmasked held neural values.

machine_output.predictions: Behavior predictions on every held timepoint/missingness mask/ratio/seed/method and declared filtering or smoothing information profile.
machine_output.tables: Full published missingness curve, LDM/SAE imputation comparisons and full-observation degradation, session outcomes and latency/cost.
machine_output.artifacts: All mask identities, valid support, train-only normalization/manifold and inference configuration.

scoring: BehaviorCC under complete original ratios/masks and independently fixed grouped error curve for prospective improvement. Do not resolve the retained dossier versus review wording discrepancy by assuming0.3/0.6 mean observed or dropped; source-bound definition remains a blocker.
protected_split: Whole temporal blocks/session with masks selected independently of held labels. Past-only filtering; future observations/imputation only in explicitly noncausal smoothing. TRAIN-only manifold/normalization and inner DEV choice.
comparators: DFINE versus LDM Kalman filter/smoother and SAE source-defined zero/average imputations; identical masks across methods, zero-signal/full-observed controls. Any burst dropout remains prospective sensitivity within this task.
distinctness: Missing-observation inference estimand is separately interpretable from DPAD nonlinear-locus attribution and existing chronological drift tasks.
